editorial:
Imagine finding out you just inherited a huge, fancy house in Texas from a grandma you never knew. That is exactly what happens to the main character, who heads out on a road trip with her friends to check out the place. At first, it feels like a lucky break because the Victorian mansion is gorgeous. But the vibe shifts real quick once they realize they are not alone. You will feel the tension build as they discover that the house has some dark secrets hidden in the basement, and a very scary man with a chainsaw is waiting for them.

What really works here is the gore and the fast pace, though the plot is a bit messy. The acting is decent for a slasher, and the twists will definitely surprise you if you have not seen the old movies. If you love blood and screams, you should definitely check this out. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical shelf is the way to go for the best picture quality. It is a fun ride for a Friday night.
endingExplained: You find out that the main girl is actually part of the crazy family. The big twist is that the man with the chainsaw is her actual grandfather. In the final fight, she manages to fight back and wins. She ends up killing him and survives the nightmare. The movie wraps up with her escaping the house, though the reveal of her family bloodline leaves you feeling a bit uneasy about her future.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves bloody horror movies and shocking family twists.
